fusions.name: Drawn Filament
fusions.desc: Draws out a filament of raw mana that deals 5 damage to the first enemy it meets, with a 30% chance per hit to leave it [Exposed] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Unpicked Ward
fusions.desc: Unpicks the target's resistances with a thrown filament, dealing 28 damage that ignores resistances, up to 1.3 times as much at full reach.

fusions.name: Wound Spool
fusions.desc: Winds spooled mana back into you, restoring 4 mana a second for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Charged Bobbin
fusions.desc: The moment your mana is full, your next spell deals 30% more damage. Once every 20 seconds.
